text:
maria gomez: Quick run-through for "Morning Canvas" launch tomorrow AM. Need final assets, UTMs, and who owns comment followups. :rocket:
alex lee: uploading final cuts now. 30s hero + 3 thumbnails (v1/v2/v3). will post path in thread when done. :movie_camera:
sam irwin: Drafted microthread + LN long form. X gets concise technical hook, LinkedIn gets product story + CTA.
olivia chan: prefer X = technical (drives clicks). LinkedIn = narrative + registration CTA.
jordan reyes: Routing plan: DMs -> @sam irwin, comment replies -> community queue. i'll triage morning sweep 09:00 PST.
maria gomez: Alex please name files: morning-canvas-hero-30s.mp4, morning-canvas-thumb-v1.jpg, -v2.jpg, -v3.jpg and include alt text in the upload notes.
alex lee: done. uploaded to /marketing/assets/morning-canvas/hero/ and added alt text.

maria gomez: UTM block for tracking (replace {variant} with x-tech / x-story / ln-prod):
```?utm_source=social&utm_medium={platform}&utm_campaign=mc_launch_q2&utm_content={variant}```
sam irwin: i'll substitute platform + variant in scheduler.

jess-bot: Reminder: preflight checklist ping will post at 08:05 PST. :robot_face:
social-scheduler: X post queued for 08:45 PST (copy A + hero30 + thumb-v1). LinkedIn queued for 09:00 PST (copy B + static v2).

maria gomez: We need a 3-tweet microthread for X. Root + 3 replies. Sam, can you drop the three followups here? Keep each ~1 line.
sam irwin: Posting microthread now:
"maria gomez: Root: Building LLM features often means trading latency for cost. Morning Canvas flips that: predictable latency, lower unit costs. Demo + checklist: <link>?utm_content=x-tech :eyes:
Followup 1: Peek at the dashboard: realtime token cost breakdown + route-level SLAs.
Followup 2: Autoscaling example: how we kept latency steady during a 3x traffic spike. (customer-teaser)
Followup 3: Register for a live demo + quick 10-min setup guide. link in comment. :sparkles:"

olivia chan: tiny tweak: on LinkedIn replace "link in comment" with "registration link". Use more product storytelling there.
sam irwin: updated LN copy accordingly.

maria gomez: Engagement prep: Olivia will draft top-10 reply templates. Jordan will build Airtable view to track registrants -> SDRs. Alex: send a small looping GIF for comment replies.
olivia chan: drafting reply templates now; will post first 5 by 08:50 PST.
jordan reyes: creating Airtable view and webhook to send new registrants to sales@redwood.com. will share link.
alex lee: GIF ready, optimized for X (6s loop) and LinkedIn (static fallback). uploaded.

maria gomez: Preflight items for 08:05 PST: 1) assets present 2) UTMs correct 3) avatars + handles correct 4) compliance check. I'll run brand/compliance.
jess-bot: preflight ping set for 08:05 PST in this thread.

social-scheduler: Preflight completed at 08:06 PST: assets ok, UTMs present, scheduled posts confirmed.
maria gomez: final ask 
- Split test angle: headline = speed vs. savings (50/50). Sam mark copy variants x-tech-A (speed) and x-tech-B (savings) in scheduler.
sam irwin: done. will pull engagement metrics after 2 hours and report back.

jordan reyes: FYI i'll be monitoring morning sweep comments 09:00-12:00 PST then handing off to community at noon. Tag me for escalations.
alex lee: good luck team :thumbsup:
